name: chalanpro-landing
description: Landing page y funnel de marketing para ChalanPro

scripts.build: mkdir -p dist && tailwindcss -i ./src/input.css -o ./dist/output.css --minify && cp src/*.html src/sitemap.xml src/robots.txt dist/ && (cp -r src/img dist/ 2>/dev/null || mkdir -p dist/img) && mkdir -p dist/icons && cp -f src/icons/* dist/icons/
